help.guildSummary: A room with a purpose — feeds, members, roles.
help.guildDetail: Everyone can read. Invite only gates joining and posting. Guild ID sticks. Collaborative governance routes changes through proposals.

help.hubDetail: Primary category powers browse. Hub ID sticks. Commission hits every sale.
help.tokenSummary: {near} NEAR · your own token under your wallet.
help.tokenDetail: Name, symbol, and supply are permanent. Contract id comes from the name — e.g. cool.you.testnet. One batch: create account, fund, deploy contract, mint to you. You can change the icon later until you lock admin — that ends all admin control.
